log_mutation.arg1: (() => {     state.milestones = state.milestones || {};     let m = (bn) => {         if (!(bn in state.milestones) && (buildings[bn]?.count || projects[bn]?.count || techIds[bn]?.isResearched()))             state.milestones[bn] = game.global.stats.days;     };     state.milestonesAvail = [         "tech-merchandising",         "SpaceTestLaunch",         "BeltIronShip",         "tech-elerium_tech",         "tech-scout_ship",         "tech-xeno_linguistics",         "Alien2Mission"     ];      state.milestonesTranslations = {         "tech-merchandising": "营销",         "SpaceTestLaunch":"试射",         "tech-elerium_tech":"超铀",         "tech-scout_ship":"侦察舰",         "tech-xeno_linguistics":"遭遇外星人",         "Alien2Mission":"海盗",         "BeltIronShip":"采矿船"     };      state.milestonesAvail.forEach(bn => m(bn));      return false; })()

log_prestige_format.ret: {eval:evolve.races[evolve.global.race.species].name}{timeStamp}天{eval:state.rlevel[evolve.alevel()-1]+'飞'} , {eval:evolve.global.prestige.Harmony.count}水, {eval: state.sr ? state.sr+'天来'+evolve.global.race.servants.max+'鼠':'鼠去'}。{eval:state.milestonesAvail.map(m => state.milestones[m] ? state.milestones[m] + '天' + state.milestonesTranslations[m] : '').filter(s => s !== '').join(', ')}——————————{eval: evolve.loc('sign_'+state.astroSign)}
